message.content:
I’m afraid the built‑in hotel‑search tool can’t filter on “vegetarian meals” or “spa services,” so I’ll give you a few well‑known yoga‑retreat options in New York that are known to offer both vegetarian dining and spa amenities:

| Retreat / Hotel | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services |
|-----------------|----------|------------------|--------------|
| **The Garrison** | Garrison, NY (about 1 hr north of NYC) | Yes – all meals are vegetarian‑friendly and many are fully plant‑based | On‑site spa with massages, facials, and wellness treatments |
| **The Ritz‑Carlton, New York, Central Park** | Manhattan | Vegetarian options available at the restaurant and room service | Full‑service spa with sauna, steam, and massage rooms |
| **The Westin New York at Times Square** | Manhattan | Vegetarian menu items at the hotel restaurant and in-room dining | Westin’s “Well‑ness” spa with massages, facials, and fitness center |
| **The Four Seasons Hotel New York** | Manhattan | Vegetarian meals offered at the hotel’s restaurants | Four Seasons Spa with a range of treatments, sauna, and fitness center |

**How to book:**

1. **Call or visit the retreat’s website** – most of these places have online booking portals where you can specify dietary preferences and request spa treatments in advance.
2. **Ask about a yoga‑focused package** – many of these hotels offer special yoga packages that include daily classes, meditation sessions, and sometimes even a “yoga‑and‑spas” discount.
3. **Confirm vegetarian meals** – when you book, double‑check that the meals will be vegetarian‑only or that you can request a vegetarian menu for your stay.

If you’d like more detailed information on any of these options (e.g., pricing, availability, or specific yoga instructors), let me know and I can help you dig deeper!
